Start year.note: The public notice of the Saxony-Anhalt state administration from August 2025 says that, according to the application of Saale Energie GmbH, the new plant is to be put into operation in 2029. No start year was in the earlier findings.

Status Detail.value: Change permit application by Saale Energie GmbH under the emissions law, public display 25 August to 24 September 2025, public hearing 20 November 2025. A first partial permit for the gatehouse was granted on 19 March 2026 and the final investment decision is pending.
Status Detail.note: The August 2025 notice and the November 2025 hearing notice are official publications. They add the application and hearing dates to the first partial permit and the early start already found in the earlier batch. No permit for the turbines has been published, so the status stays pre-construction.

units.notes: The two saved notices give the applicant, the dates and the 2029 start, but no electric output of the new plant and no turbine maker. They mention only the existing coal blocks at about 915 MW gross. The environmental impact report that would hold output and site data could not be read because the register refused every request with error 429 after many retries. The project is moving, with a partial permit in March 2026, so Latest Activity is left alone. The applicant Saale Energie GmbH matches the owner already found.

qa.note: The application covers a combined cycle plant, a standby power plant and an industrial gas turbine plant, called IGT, at the same site. GEM has one unit of 900 MW. The saved notices do not split the capacity between the parts.
